printed_field_counts.source: athletes printed on each race of the per-round Start Lists of the results book

rerace_log.event: Women - Canoe Head to Head Sprint
rerace_log.source: Official Communication "Race rescheduled" Item 1, Race 84, issued by the ICF Technical Delegate 13:08 13 OCT 2018 (results book page 113): "The race 2 has to be rescheduled due to an athlete interfering in this race. The new date and start time is 13.10.2018 at 13:20."
rerace_log.rule: reraces kept at their own printed start time under the original phase/unit, logged (2026-10-16); the original run keeps its start-list clock with no result, the Result List ranks/times go on the rerace

course_to_lane.rule: Course A written STARTING_LANE 1, Course B written 2 (head-to-head pairs; the book prints the course letter, the contract wants a number); question on the PR

phase_not_in_contract.written: PHASE empty, UNIT "Repechage N" / "Last 16 N" with the printed race number; the contract PHASE set is heat|quarterfinal|semifinal|final (no repechage, no last 16); question on the PR

heat_repechage_rank.rule: Qualification Heats and Repechages print one Result List per round ranked by time, no per-race place; RANK = that printed round rank (question on the PR)

finals.rule: Finals race 1 "For Bronze" = final UNIT B, race 2 "For Gold" = final UNIT A; RANK = Round Results Summary place 1-4 (podium = Medallists page); race place logged in final_rank_from_summary

sprint.quote: The Head to Head Sprint is an individual event on a 420m figure-of-eight course

obstacle_slalom.quote: a course approximately 60m in length in each direction, with four pairs of buoys on each course, to give a race length of 120m

category.rule: the book prints no category word; YOG canoe athletes are junior age (2000-2001 births); question on the PR

dates_note.printed: FRI 12 OCT 2018 to TUE 16 OCT 2018 on the start and result lists; Men Kayak Obstacle Slalom and Women Canoe Obstacle Slalom ran TUE 16 OCT
